svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.10.22.2 Vertical Clearances above Cooktops
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.22.2 Vertical Clearances above Cooktops
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Vertical Clearances above Cooktops

g.text: Reduced to 600 mm where the framing,
or protected by a metal hood projecting 125 mm

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Framing, finishes and cabinetry installed
directly above the location of the cooktop are
not less than 750 mm (29½″) above the level of
cooktop burners or elements
Except as provided in Sentence (2).
That clearance may be reduced to 600 mm (23⅝″)
above the elements or burners
Provided the framing, finishes and cabinets (a)
are noncombustible, or (b) are protected by a
metal hood that projects 125 mm (4 15/16″) beyond
the framing, finishes and cabinets.
These minimum vertical clearances apply only to
combustible framing, finishes and cabinets. They
do not apply to microwave ovens installed over
cooktops nor to range hoods.
Drawn: a kitchen with near walls removed. Burner level is the top of the range.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.22.2. (page 9-102), with Note A-9.10.22.
